answer.summary: No existing evidence supports memory mechanisms operating without feature extraction or vector representations in stable, low-variation environments.
answer.content: The reviewed literature lacks explicit, non-feature-based indicators of memory coherence, persistence, or self-correction under stable input conditions. A new research focus is needed to explore how such mechanisms might emerge in systems with minimal external structure or supervision.
